title: Self Assessment campaign tracking 2025 to 2026
text:
Each year HMRC runs a comprehensive communications programme to encourage Self Assessment customer to file their Tax Return early, register for Self Assessment ahead of the registration deadline, and file their online Tax Return by the deadline of 31 January. A paid-for advertising campaign running between late December and the end of January is a final reminder to customers, driving urgency and prompting customers to file on-time.

 This survey research was designed to understand the effectiveness of the 2025 to 2026 Self Assessment advertising campaign. It was conducted with unrepresented Self Assessment customers before and after the advertising campaign. The pre-campaign ran from 21 November 2025 to 23 December 2025 (513 respondents). The post-campaign ran from 2 February 2026 to 2 March 2026 (535 respondents).
